answer: Recursive Path-Diversity Flow Routing** Nodes route data only through independent topological bridges called a beacon to confirm valid neighborhood density. Every active agent must maintain active pathways into a distinct routing harbor without overlapping edge-sets. The protocol measures maximum disjoint graph cuts relative to a global anchor. Attackers spawning mass clones duplicate local edge clusters instead of distinct cuts, which collapses their aggregate throughput score below the minimum transmission threshold.
